Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited to kick off the renewal + uplift planning for Stellar Data. Per our notes you mentioned a 2x token uptick across your search/assist routes and wanting an operational runbook in place before the next billing cycle.

High-level proposal (attached: MA-Timeline.xlsx + Stellar_Uplift_Proposal_v1.pdf):
- Target term: 12-month renewal with staged capacity increases (Q1: +20%, Q2: +30%, Q3: +50%).
- Priority routes: /search (low-latency), /chat-assist (high-throughput).
- QBR window: week of Nov 16 — we'd like to align exec stakeholders and an ops run-through.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm who from your ops team will attend the QBR (we suggest Prod Eng + Procurement).
2) Preferred week/day for the working session (we can do a 60–90 minute slot).
3) Any compliance/contract items procurement needs in advance (PO number, SOW draft).

Proposed next step: I’ll send a short calendar poll for Nov 16–19. If that looks tight, we can move to the following week.

I’m looping Ben (account exec) and Grace (solutions lead) to scope the runbook and finalize the QBR agenda.

Attachments: Stellar_Uplift_Proposal_v1.pdf (proposal overview), MA-Timeline.xlsx (staged capacity timeline)

Thanks,
— Soojin
